from rdflib import Graph
from datetime import date

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

  OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd }

    gd=g.value(s,u("hasGraduationDate"))

    is_big=any(d in big for d in depts)
    if is_eu and is_big:
        countries=sorted({str(g.value(g.value(d,u("belongsTo")),u("locatedInCountry"))) for d in depts})
